rerunRule: Do not rerun this protocol merely for filming or publication. If either source or compiled XCTest changes, create a new preregistration and evidence bundle rather than replacing this one.

latestSemanticDelta.name: exact degree-one constant-fill input packing
latestSemanticDelta.summary: The degree-one branch writes selected encoded low[0]/high[0] values directly while retaining all timed pointer binding and all 17 times lanes writes; the degree-greater-than-one path and graph/decode/digest/timing contracts remain unchanged.
latestSemanticDelta.limitation: The predecessor identifier is a coordination checkpoint, but its bytes were not retained as a Git object. The semantic delta is bound by preregistration and review, not by a recoverable byte diff.

publicationWording.primary: At B=65,536 under the accepted paired scope, HELUT measured 8.544087 ms versus 7.421917 ms for 16-worker Verilator: HELUT remained 15.1% slower, with no paired crossover through B=65,536.
publicationWording.historical: The warmed graph-only comparison is intentionally asymmetric and may show sampled graph amortization; it is not the paired throughput verdict.
publicationWording.digest: The ordered digest is required shared work inside both paired timers. It must not be subtracted post hoc to synthesize a separate evaluator ratio.
publicationWording.scope: Five unpinned trials at each of eight widths for one combinational 8-bit ripple adder on one Mac16,5 host; no general HDL, sequential, cross-host, or best-possible-native claim follows.

knownEvidenceCaveats: The sealed preregistration/raw log/receipt render local -0700 mtimes with a Z suffix; epoch, byte size, and hashes are correct. See ERRATA.md.
raw.log was banked from the complete returned sole-run output after session compaction rather than streamed directly to its final path.
The generated simulator binary and resynth.json are hash-identified but their bytes are not copied into this evidence directory.
